note: 50 forced-choice items adapted from topics covered by ANES and Pew Research Center U.S. surveys. direction 'L' means agreement indicates a left-of-center position; 'R' means agreement indicates a right-of-center position. 25 L / 25 R to control acquiescence bias. Likert values: Strongly agree=2, Agree=1, Neutral=0, Disagree=-1, Strongly disagree=-2. Item score = value * (direction=='L' ? -1 : +1), so negative totals = left lean, positive = right lean.

items.statement: The United States should build substantial physical barriers along its southern border.
Immigrants strengthen the country because of their hard work and talents.
Undocumented immigrants who were brought to the United States as children should be given a path to citizenship.
Local police should be required to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement.
Legal immigration levels to the United States should be reduced.
Abortion should be legal in all or most cases.
Abortion should be illegal after a fetal heartbeat can be detected.
Health insurance plans should be required to cover contraception.
Doctors should be legally required to inform parents before a minor obtains an abortion.
The federal government should protect access to abortion nationwide.
There should be a nationwide ban on the sale of assault-style weapons.
More Americans carrying concealed firearms would make the country safer.
Teachers and school officials should be allowed to carry guns in schools.
The government should require background checks for all gun purchases, including private sales.
Stricter gun laws would do little to reduce violent crime.
The federal government should require utilities to generate more electricity from renewable sources.
Expanding oil and gas drilling on federal lands is good policy.
Climate change is a major threat that requires immediate government action.
Environmental regulations cost too many jobs and hurt the economy.
The United States should remain in international climate agreements.
The federal minimum wage should be raised to at least fifteen dollars an hour.
Corporate tax rates should be cut to encourage economic growth.
The government should guarantee health insurance for all citizens, even if it means raising taxes.
Government regulation of business usually does more harm than good.
The wealthy should pay a larger share of taxes than they do now.
Spending on police departments should increase.
Racial discrimination is a major factor in how police treat Black Americans.
Judges should hand down longer sentences for violent crime.
Too many nonviolent offenders are held in American prisons.
The death penalty is an appropriate punishment for murder.
Public schools should be allowed to teach that racism is built into American laws and institutions.
Parents should be able to use public funds to send their children to private or religious schools.
Transgender athletes should be allowed to compete on sports teams that match their gender identity.

Public schools place too little emphasis on patriotism and American achievements.
Government aid to the poor does more good than harm.
Able-bodied adults should be required to work in order to receive government benefits.
Prescription drug prices should be capped by the federal government.
Private health insurance generally delivers better care than government-run programs.
Forgiving federal student loan debt is good policy.
The United States should continue military aid to Ukraine.
The United States spends too much defending other countries that should defend themselves.

Voting by mail should be available to any voter who wants it.
